defect: Open-deferrals ledger row 49 (line 206) contains a literal escaped pipe `packratEnter(): PackratEpoch \| null`. parseChronicTable splits cells on `.split("|")`, which does NOT honor markdown `\|` escaping, so the row parses as 7 cells instead of 6. The header-resolved closure column is fixed index 5, so the parser reads only the truncated fragment `` `PACKRAT_ARMED` latch; `packratEnter(): PackratEpoch \` `` and DROPS the real closure content (the `Oracle:` born-RED clause + §8-13 ref, which land in cells[6]). This directly violates the doc's own line-122 claim that the rows are 'ONE flat table (the R/Q/L/K/J/I shape parseChronicTable accepts byte-for-byte)'. Confirmed by running the parser against S: row 49 spuriously reds ('names NO load-bearing proof:* gate and no non-gate mechanism') because its closure text is severed.
fix: On line 206 replace `packratEnter(): PackratEpoch \| null` with `packratEnter(): PackratEpoch or null` (remove the literal pipe entirely — no `\|` escape works with a naive split). Exact edit: change `PackratEpoch \| null` to `PackratEpoch or null`.

defect: The same literal escaped pipe `packratEnter(): PackratEpoch \| null` appears in the wave-board table on line 75 (S.H1 row). The wave board is not the proof:chronic-closure parse target so it does not break that gate, but it is the identical malformed-cell hazard and should be fixed for consistency (any future board-parsing gate would hit the 8-cell split observed).
fix: On line 75 replace `PackratEpoch \| null` with `PackratEpoch or null` (same fix as row 49).
